text.description_html:
Laurey 39128, Industrial Wired Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel

The 3 Inch Satin Nickel Wired Cabinet Pull has a unique lined design that will add an industrial look to any cool kitchen remodel. Pair this with a brick wall and Edison bulbs for an industrial chic vibe that anyone living in a New York apartment would envy. The Industrial Wired Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel is bold and refuses to blend into the background.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Wired Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39128 3 Inch Wired Pull Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available finishes:
Satin Nickel Matte Black

Sold Individually
